title: Grilled Bratwurst with Sauerkraut and Potatoes
description: A classic German dish featuring grilled bratwurst, tangy sauerkraut, and tender potatoes, all roasted to perfection.
instructions: Grill the bratwurst for 5-7 minutes per side, or until nicely charred.
Meanwhile, toss the sliced potatoes and challots with a little oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the potato mixture for 5-7 minutes per side, or until tender and lightly browned.
Serve the grilled bratwurst with sauerkraut, potatoes, and a dollop of American mustard.
Garnish with fresh parsley or chives, if desired.
